## Episode Thesis

This episode reviews the Swedish Q3 2026 reporting season. The guest analyst (Peter Malmqvist) reports that earnings have risen for two quarters in a row, at about 10% a year, and sales and order intake are accelerating. Results came in slightly below estimates, but the beat was broad across sectors. He sees no sign that the upturn is breaking. Valuations are stretched relative to earnings in both Sweden and the US. Falling oil prices ease inflation and rate worries. Strong AI-driven order books at Atlas Copco, Alfa Laval and ABB got surprisingly cool share-price reactions, which the speakers put down to positioning and sentiment.
